learning_outcomes.text: Knows and classifies energy sources and power plants in general.
Can perform energy calculations in hydraulic power plants.
Can perform energy calculations in wind power plants.
Can perform energy calculations in wave energy power plants.
Performs blade design with BEM theory.

syllabus_topics: Operating principles of energy power plants
Wind Energy Power Plants and Types
Wind Energy Power Plant Facilities Elements
Energy Production Calculation in Wind Energy Power Plants
Wave Energy Power Plants and Types
Wave Energy Power Plant Facilities Elements
Energy Production Calculation in Wave Energy Power Plants
Hydraulic Energy Power Plants and Types
Hydraulic Energy Power Plant Facilities Elements
Energy Production Calculation in Hydraulic Energy Power Plants
assessment_rules: The overall grade is calculated based on 60% in-term achievement and 40% final exam. In-term achievement is determined by 55% midterm exam, 25% homework, and 20% performance task (seminar).
